source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: What does tokenization do to text before a decoder transformer processes it?

options.text: Assigns a probability to each complete answer.
options.feedback: Next-token probabilities come later in the pipeline. Tokenization prepares the text for numerical processing.

options.text: Splits text into pieces with vocabulary identifiers.
options.feedback: A token can be a word or a piece of a word. Its identifier lets the model map that piece to a numerical representation.

options.text: Converts each sentence into a verified factual claim.
options.feedback: Tokenization handles the representation of text. It does not check whether a sentence is true.

options.text: Stores each paragraph as an independent learned weight.
options.feedback: Learned weights are model parameters. Input paragraphs become token sequences rather than new weights.
